tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Read-only: list/search the tenant catalog (products and SKUs). Optional query and limit. Does not create, modify, or delete anything.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Read-only: fetch a single catalog product by ID. Does not create, modify, or delete anything.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Read-only: list prices for the tenant. Optional sku and limit filters. Does not create, modify, or delete anything.

tools.name: get_inventory
tools.description: Read-only: list stock/availability for the tenant. Optional sku and limit filters. Does not create, modify, or delete anything.

tools.name: get_order_history
tools.description: Read-only: list recent orders for the authenticated tenant. Optional limit. Does not create, modify, or delete anything.

tools.name: complete_checkout_session
tools.description: Complete checkout and create the order. Idempotent per session: calling this again with the same session_id returns the SAME order and never double-ch
